description:
Baek Hyeon-Woo harbors a secret he must never let his childhood friend Lee Seo-Hun discover. That secret is that he's been secretly in love with Seo-Hun since the moment they first met. As soon as he turned 20, he was practically forced into living together with Seo-Hun, and all he can do is masturbate with a dildo while thinking of him. Living in torment, Hyeon-Woo finds a suspicious app called "Hypnosis" installed on his phone. A sentence he typed in as a joke becomes reality. “Baby.” The hypnosis begins with that one word. Torn between irresistible temptation and guilt, Hyeon-Woo sinks deeper into turmoil.

This dangerous game started with hypnosis. Can Hyeon-Woo ever tell Seo-Hun the truth?

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)
